from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4ecf9682.py')

code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=g[0][0]
    # Find the rectangular non-background pattern and zero-colored target rectangle.
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,0)]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    pattern=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in g[r0:r1+1]]
    targets=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(g) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
    tr0=min(r for r,c in targets); tr1=max(r for r,c in targets)
    tc0=min(c for r,c in targets); tc1=max(c for r,c in targets)
    for i in range(tr1-tr0+1):
        for j in range(tc1-tc0+1):
            g[tr0+i][tc0+j]=pattern[i][len(pattern[0])-1-j]
    return g
'''
